name: FormTools
title: viewers, batch tools and desktop utilities in one window
summary: FormTools is the Form family's utility belt: viewers for almost any file, batch image tools, 3D viewing and desktop utilities in one window, with no account.
lede: FormTools is the Form family's utility belt. It opens RAW, HDR, EXR, PSD, video, audio, 3D models, fonts, PDFs, databases and archives in one app, converts, resizes and renames whole folders, and adds desktop utilities on global shortcuts. Every file is read on this computer and nothing is uploaded.
checks: Opens RAW, HDR, EXR, PSD, video, audio, 3D models, fonts, PDFs, databases and archives in one app.
Converts, resizes and renames whole folders with an ordered action pipeline, a live preview and shared presets.
Includes a colour picker, screen ruler, text extractor, zoom and draw, break timer and more on global shortcuts.
Runs the same engine from the window, the CLI and an MCP server with 30 tools.

facts.dd: Vanilla TypeScript and Vite, on port 5240 in development
Python and FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8240, with 8 tool modules registered at start
A Tauri 2 shell that starts its own engine on a free port
FFmpeg (LGPL build) for playback, inspection and lossless clips; transcoding stays in FormEncoder

chapters.title: One window for almost any file
chapters.text: The folder browser shows thumbnails with star ratings, colour labels and multi-select. The image viewer crops, resizes, saves as another format, compares and inspects pixels, and rates and labels from the keyboard.

chapters.title: Chain actions, check the names, then convert
chapters.text: Batch convert takes an ordered list of actions, a format and naming tokens, and shows the resulting names before it runs. Undo is built in.

chapters.title: View, measure and inspect models
chapters.text: The 3D viewer plays animation, measures, shows triangle and vertex counts, and converts to GLB, OBJ, STL, PLY or OFF.
